en.title: AI Films from Kerala to Andaman Islands Debut at IFFI Goa
en.summary: Five groundbreaking AI-generated films, created across India using Google Flow, have reached the finals of the WIF India x Google Flow Filmathon. These innovative works will screen at the prestigious International Film Festival of India in Goa.
en.body:
The cinematic landscape is evolving at warp speed, and the upcoming International Film Festival of India (IFFI) in Goa is set to showcase a fascinating glimpse into its future. Five short films, born from the intersection of human creativity and artificial intelligence, have been selected as finalists for the inaugural **WIF India x Google Flow Filmathon**. These remarkable pieces, crafted by filmmakers hailing from as far afield as Kerala in the south to the Andaman and Nicobar Islands in the east, represent a significant step in AI-assisted storytelling and will be screened at IFFI Goa in November 2026.

The Filmathon, a collaboration between **Women in Film India (WIF India)** and **Google Flow**, an AI creative workspace, aims to empower storytellers to explore new frontiers in filmmaking. Google Flow provides a platform for creators to develop and refine their cinematic ideas with AI's assistance, offering tools that can help bring complex visions to life. This initiative not only champions technological innovation but also underscores WIF India's commitment to expanding access and opportunities within the film community.

> "Google Flow is already gaining remarkable momentum in India," says **Arathi Sethumadhavan**, director, international activations and product insights, technology and society, Google. "Through the Filmathon, in collaboration with WIF India, we can’t wait to see the short films storytellers across the country bring to life, and how they expand the boundaries of artistic expression through this technology."

## AI Unleashed on the Silver Screen

This unique competition provided a canvas for filmmakers to experiment with AI tools, pushing the envelope of what's possible in short-form narrative. The selection of finalists from diverse geographical and cultural backgrounds across India speaks to the broad reach and accessibility of these new technologies. For the participating filmmakers, the ultimate prize is the opportunity to present their AI-crafted narratives on a grand stage at IFFI Goa. This showcase offers a vital platform to move their work beyond the realm of experimentation and into direct engagement with a wider filmmaking community, industry professionals, and a discerning global audience.

## A New Era for Indian Cinema?

The implications of this Filmathon extend beyond the individual filmmakers. It serves as a powerful indicator of how AI is becoming an integrated tool in the creative process, rather than just a futuristic concept. For fans of cinema, this means anticipating a new wave of visually inventive and conceptually daring films. The ability to leverage AI could democratize filmmaking further, allowing more diverse voices and stories to emerge from every corner of India. The screenings at IFFI Goa will offer a crucial insight into the artistic merit and narrative potential of AI-generated cinema, sparking conversations about its future role in the industry.

## What's Next

The five finalist films will be screened at the **International Film Festival of India (IFFI)** in Goa in November 2026. This event promises to be a significant moment for AI in filmmaking, offering a glimpse into the innovative works developed through the **WIF India x Google Flow Filmathon**.
